title: Heavy Rain in the City
text:
Yesterday, heavy rain fell on the city all afternoon. Many streets were full of water, and some buses were late. The local news reported the problem on the evening show.

The weather office says more rain will come this weekend. People are asked to take care when they drive. The city will open a special center for families who need help.

questions.text: When did the heavy rain fall on the city?
What will the city open for families?
Why were some buses late yesterday?
options: The streets had a lot of water

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the weather this weekend?
options: It will be sunny and warm
It may be wet and dangerous for drivers
It will snow in the city
There will be no weather news

vocabulary.definition: very strong or in large amounts
public roads in a town or city
to tell people about something that happened
different from usual, made for a particular purpose

paragraph_translations: Ayer, una lluvia intensa cayó sobre la ciudad toda la tarde. Muchas calles estaban llenas de agua y algunos autobuses llegaron tarde. Las noticias locales informaron del problema en el programa de la noche.
La oficina del tiempo dice que habrá más lluvia este fin de semana. Se pide a la gente que tenga cuidado al conducir. La ciudad abrirá un centro especial para las familias que necesiten ayuda.
